# Olas Realtor Consulting Ltd

> Premier Nigerian Real Estate Consulting, Strategic Advisory, Verified Acquisitions, Title Regularization (C of O), and Executive Asset Management.

## Overview
Olas Realtor Consulting Ltd is a corporate real estate consulting and property advisory firm headquartered in Abeokuta, Ogun State, Nigeria. Founded and led by Kolade Abiola Daramola, the firm specializes in risk-free property acquisitions, institutional land banking, statutory title perfection (Certificate of Occupancy and Governor’s Consent), facility management, and bespoke real estate advisory for diaspora investors across the United Kingdom, United States, and Canada.

## Core Capabilities
- **Property Sales & Acquisitions**: Verified land banks and residential developments with comprehensive registry due diligence and survey coordinate matching.
- **Asset & Facility Management**: Institutional tenant screening, structured rent collection, routine facility upkeep, and asset governance.
- **Title Documentation & Regularization**: Expedited Certificate of Occupancy (C of O), Governor’s Consent, Deed of Assignment, and registered survey processing with Ogun State Bureau of Lands.
- **Valuation & Advisory**: Certified market appraisals, feasibility studies, mortgage valuations, and diaspora portfolio structuring.

## Primary Coverage Areas
- Abeokuta, Ogun State (Headquarters): Ibara GRA, Oluwo, Osoba Hilltop, Kuto, Dubai Destiny Estate, Abiola Way Corridor.
- Western Nigeria Growth Axis (Sagamu, Mowe-Ibafo, Interchange, Lagos-Ogun Border).
- Overseas Diaspora Hubs (UK, USA, Canada, Europe).
